notes: Enhanced synthetic fixture designed to test complex multi-layered hybrid content with comprehensive vector shape coverage. This fixture represents a realistic document with multiple structural elements (headers, footers, columns, annotations, shapes) creating hybrid cells across most of the page. Key additions: circular shapes using cubic Bezier curves (12 curveto operators), rectangles (6 operators), lines (3 operators), demonstrating PDF's transparency model with proper layer ordering. With 87.5% hybrid cells, it tests the upper bound of hybrid detection and validates that the classifier correctly handles complex real-world layouts where vector elements serve both content and structural purposes (dividers, borders, layout guides, circular annotations).
